newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-SCHUTTE WINS FIRST TITLE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SCHUTTE WINS FIRST TITLE.

text.p: South Africa's Warren Schutte shot a seven-under-par 65 on Sunday to win the first title of his professional career.
Schutte, a burly 25-year-old, recorded a two-stroke victory in the Players' Championship at the Durban Country Club after compiling a 72-hole total of 274.
The 1991 U.S. Collegiate champion, 14th on the 1995-96 South African Order of Merit, overtook and then beat off compatriot Nico van Rensburg, who eventually came second with a final 67.
Schutte effectively sealed the title with four successive birdies from the 10th, holing from 30 feet at the 11th and 25 feet at the 12th.
Overnight leader Andre Cruse of South Africa was third after slipping to a 71.
World number 15 Mark McNulty of Zimbabwe, winner of the last three events on the South African tour, finished joint 10th on 282 after a 68.
